identity.name: AgentQL MCP
identity.one_liner: Model Context Protocol server that exposes AgentQL data extraction capabilities to AI agents.
identity.short_description: AgentQL MCP is an open-source Model Context Protocol server that integrates AgentQL's data extraction capabilities. It is relevant for agents that need structured web data extraction through an MCP-compatible tool surface.

positioning.why_it_matters: Agents often need reliable data extraction from web pages, not just screenshots or raw HTML. AgentQL MCP packages that capability as an MCP server that compatible agent hosts can call.
best_for: Developers building web data extraction tools for agents
Builders who need Playwright and AgentQL-style extraction in workflows
not_for: Teams that only need passive browsing
Workflows where external web extraction is not allowed

seo_article.intro: AgentQL MCP is an open-source Model Context Protocol server for AgentQL web data extraction.
seo_article.what_it_is: It gives AI agents an MCP-compatible tool surface for extracting structured data from web pages.
seo_article.why_it_matters: Web agents become more useful when they can extract reliable structured data rather than only browse pages.
seo_article.how_it_works: Start with a non-sensitive page, configure the MCP server, and compare extracted data against the source before automating broader workflows.
